answer: Spiral Assignment Registry.** Each epoch, a public verifiable-randomness beacon derives a hidden spiral ordering of agent IDs; a rolling challenge vine selects which identities must answer a live, time-boxed capability proof, published only after the beacon output. Because the ordering is unpredictable before the beacon, an attacker cannot precompute which fake identities need costly proofs, nor stagger registrations to dodge them. Any identity failing its drawn challenge is ivory-flagged and removed with its deposit.
